title: Starter Contrast Hero + Journey Thermometer and Step Snapshots
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Refresh the Quickstart landing hero to improve clarity for first-time engineers and reduce time-to-first-call. This ticket covers a high-contrast hero variant, an inline ‘journey thermometer’ (compact progress/benefit bar), three paired step snapshot illustrations, and the production screenshot capture pipeline for stable release assets.

Goals: 1) Make the hero demonstrably clearer for new users (primary CTA -> 1-click quickstart). 2) Create a distinctive visual motif (thermometer) that can be used across microsites and emails. 3) Ship responsive assets and a reproducible screenshot capture workflow for releases.

Scope: - Visual system for a high-contrast hero (desktop/desktop-narrow/tablet/mobile) with accessible color tokens. - Inline journey thermometer graphic that encodes 3 milestones (Set up, Try API, Inspect Output) with microcopy states. - Three step snapshot illustrations (code + console + result) as modular cards for the hero and doc landing. - Production screenshot checklist and a script for automated capture of hero states at target breakpoints (2x retina). - Specs for motion micro-interaction when hovering the thermometer on desktop.

Out of scope: landing copy edits outside quickstart hero, backend API changes, detailed analytics instrumentation (handled by PM-1209).
acceptance_criteria: Figma: master hero frame and componentized thermometer with tokens and exportable slices for breakpoints
Three step snapshot components (code, console, result) exported as PNG/SVG at 1x and 2x for desktop/tablet/mobile
Accessible color contrast passes WCAG AA for hero headline and CTA on all breakpoints
Production screenshot script checked into infra repo with README and CI job to generate artifacts
PM review sign-off and one round of engineering accessibility review completed
Design handoff artifact with annotations for dev: margins, responsive rules, motion easing, and fallback static states
comments: 2025-02-12 Aisha: Spun up initial exploration — created 3 visual directions: neutral, contrast-forward, and illustrative. Chose contrast-forward for legibility tests.
2025-02-14 Marco: Shared componentization plan in Figma. Asking for tokens for hover states from Design Systems (DS-313).
2025-02-16 PM Helena Nguyen: Confirmed milestones for thermometer copy. Will validate copy during PM review on 2025-02-19.
2025-02-18 Accessibility review (by Sam Ortiz): Headline contrast at 1x marginal; recommend increasing primary CTA weight and adding subtle outline for dark-mode.
2025-02-19 Marco: Implemented static PNG export script and added sample artifacts to GH PR #528. Noted slight layout shift at 768px that needs responsive spacing tweak.
2025-02-20 Aisha: Updated Figma with motion diagram and exported 2x assets. Ready for PM review tomorrow. Added edge-case artboards for long locale strings.
notes:
Design decision log: chose compact thermometer after testing with three internal engineers; it communicates progress without pushing users away from the CTA. Motion is intentionally minimal (sub-100ms scale) to avoid jittering focus. For dark mode fallback, thermometer switches to an outline motif.

Engineering handoff: include CSS vars for tokenized colors and a small JS toggle for motion-prefers-reduced-motion. Screenshot script uses puppeteer and exports at widths: 1440, 1024, 768, 360 at DPR 1 and 2.
implementation_notes: Provide a semantic DOM order: H1, paragraph, CTA, thermometer (aria-hidden=false when interactive), snapshots list after hero
Thermometer should expose aria-label with current milestone for screen readers
Export assets named: hero-thermo-{breakpoint}-{dpr}.png and snapshots-{panel}-{breakpoint}-{dpr}.png
